name: Oki Ikutoshi
source: Member of the Ikebukuro Berserkers and one of the Rankers. Ikutoshi is a rebellious boy who is always looking for a way to get stronger and is admired by Kagutsuchi who sees him as a brother figure. His Sacred Artifact allows him to transform into his adult form, greatly enhancing his fighting abilities.
